StratigraphyRunFacet.description: What a forward stratigraphic run did. START carries software and config_source; COMPLETE adds the run's checks and counts.

config_source.description: file: the config was read from the input dataset; built_in_example: no input file.

max_relative_mass_error.description: Largest per-class |initial + supplied - outflow - stored| / supplied.

ledger_replay_max_diff_m.description: Largest difference between surviving units and a replay of the event ledger.

surface_reconstruction_gap_m.description: Largest per-step difference between a surface-only reconstruction and the event record.

recycled_fraction.description: Share of surviving solid that was eroded from a unit and redeposited.

prov_document.description: File name, in the output directory, of the run's W3C PROV-O document.
